subject: Mathematics
title: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability

questions.q: The probability of any event always lies between ____.
questions.explanation: Probability is never negative and never greater than 1.

questions.q: What is the probability of getting a head in one toss of a fair coin?
questions.explanation: There are two equally likely outcomes.

questions.q: A die is rolled. What is the probability of getting a prime number?
questions.explanation: Primes on a die are 2, 3, 5, which is 3 out of 6.

questions.q: The sum of the probabilities of all outcomes of an experiment is ____.
questions.explanation: All possible outcomes together make a sure event.

questions.q: The probability of an impossible event is ____.
A bag has 3 red and 2 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
